tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Score how well a business shows up online, out of 100, and name what is hurting it most. Give it a website (and an email to send the full report to) and it runs Kashif's audit of the business's online presence: whether customers can find them in search, whether AI assistants can read them, how fast

tools.name: get_scan_result
tools.description: Collect the result of a scan that scan_website started but had not finished when it answered. Call scan_website first; if its status is "processing", wait a little (about 30 seconds) and call this with the scanId it returned. Returns the same result as scan_website: "processing" (ask again shortly),

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_website, get_scan_result · Private data: scan_website · Public sink: scan_website.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_website, get_scan_result · Private data: scan_website · Public sink: scan_website

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scan_website" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
